description: Give your agent a real US phone number: AI voice calls, SMS and iMessage, with $5 of credit and no credit card.

methods.name: dial.set_key
methods.description: Already have a Dial API key (sk_live_...)? Save it on this host; it is sent on every call and calling again replaces it. Local, free.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your sk_live_... key.

methods.name: dial.status
methods.description: Your account: credit balance, plan, and the limits currently in force (max call duration, max concurrent calls). Free. Call this first to orient.

methods.name: dial.usage
methods.description: Activity analytics: message and call counts, voice minutes, per-day series, and busiest numbers. Free.

params.name: days
params.description: How many days back to summarize (default 30).

methods.name: dial.signup
methods.description: Start creating (or signing in to) a Dial account. Emails a 6-digit code and returns a verificationId; pass both to dial.verify. Free.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address to create the account under; the 6-digit verification code is sent to it.

methods.name: dial.verify
methods.description: Redeem the emailed code. Signing in to an existing account: the API key is issued and saved on this host at once. New account: the email is verified and a registrationId comes back — Dial also requires a verified phone number that a human owns, so continue with dial.register_number. Free.

params.name: verificationId
params.description: The id returned by dial.signup.

params.name: code
params.description: The 6-digit code emailed by dial.signup.

methods.name: dial.register_number
methods.description: New accounts only: text a 6-digit code to the phone number that will own the account. Ask your human for a number they keep that can receive SMS — never invent one, and a Dial number is refused. A verified number is bound to one Dial account permanently. Free.

params.name: registrationId
params.description: From dial.verify.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: The owner's phone number, E.164 preferred (e.g. +14155550123).

methods.name: dial.verify_number
methods.description: New accounts only: submit the SMS code. This creates the account (with $5 of credit and a first number) and the API key is saved on this host automatically — every other dial.* method then works. Free.

params.name: registrationId
params.description: From dial.verify.

params.name: code
params.description: The 6-digit code from the SMS.

methods.name: dial.list_numbers
methods.description: Your phone numbers, with capabilities, setup status, and per-number inbound configuration. Free.

methods.name: dial.buy_number
methods.description: Provision a new US phone number. COSTS $3/month. Requires an explicit consent attestation because it spends money on behalf of the account holder, so confirm with your human first.

params.name: explicitProgrammaticConsent
params.description: Short human-readable attestation that the account holder consented to provisioning this number programmatically. Stored for the audit trail.

params.name: capabilities
params.description: Channels the number should support: ["sms","call"] (default), or add "imessage" for an iMessage number (provisioned asynchronously).

params.name: inboundInstruction
params.description: System prompt the AI uses on inbound calls to this number; a sensible default is used if omitted.

params.name: areaCode
params.description: Preferred US area code; omitted means any available US number. Ignored for iMessage numbers.

methods.name: dial.get_number
methods.description: One phone number by id. Free.

params.name: id
params.description: The number's Dial id.

methods.name: dial.set_number
methods.description: Update a number: nickname, inbound behavior, voice, language, call ceiling, and (iMessage numbers only) the display name and avatar recipients see. Only the fields you send change. Free.

params.name: id
params.description: The number's Dial id.

params.name: nickname
params.description: Human-readable label, e.g. "Support line". Empty string clears it.

params.name: inboundInstruction
params.description: New system prompt for inbound calls to this number.

params.name: inboundVoiceGender
params.description: Voice gender for inbound calls: "male" or "female". Omitted leaves it unchanged.

params.name: maxCallDurationSeconds
params.description: Per-call ceiling for this number, in seconds (60-3600).

methods.name: dial.release_number
methods.description: Release a number. IRREVERSIBLE: the number is gone and the unused month is not refunded. Confirm with your human first.

params.name: id
params.description: The number's Dial id.

methods.name: dial.send_message
methods.description: Send a text. Delivers over iMessage when the recipient supports it, otherwise SMS, same call either way. COSTS MONEY (US SMS $0.02 per segment). Pass exactly one of fromNumber or fromNumberId.

params.name: to
params.description: Destination phone number, E.164 (e.g. +14155550123).

params.name: fromNumber
params.description: One of your numbers in E.164 to send from.

params.name: fromNumberId
params.description: Number id to send from; defaults to your primary number.

params.name: body
params.description: Message text.

methods.name: dial.list_messages
methods.description: Your messages, inbound and outbound, newest first (up to the 100 most recent). Free. Poll this for replies, or prefer dial.wait_for_event to block until one arrives.

params.name: since
params.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only messages after this.

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter by direction: "inbound" or "outbound".

methods.name: dial.typing
methods.description: Show or clear a typing indicator before you reply. iMessage numbers display it; SMS numbers ignore it, so it is always safe to call. Sending a message clears it automatically. Free.

params.name: toNumber
params.description: Recipient phone number, E.164.

params.name: fromNumber
params.description: The number the indicator appears from: one of your numbers in E.164, its id, or nickname.

params.name: value
params.description: true to start the indicator, false to clear it.

methods.name: dial.place_call
methods.description: Place an outbound AI voice call. Returns a call id immediately; the call runs in the background. COSTS MONEY per minute. Pass transferTo to have the agent wait out hold queues and IVR menus and hand the live call to a human when a real person answers. Poll dial.get_call, or block on dial.wait_for_event with call.ended.

params.name: to
params.description: Destination phone number, E.164.

params.name: outboundInstruction
params.description: System prompt for the AI voice agent on this call.

params.name: transferTo
params.description: Number in E.164 to hand the call to a human. The agent rides out hold music and automated menus and cold-transfers the moment a real person answers — never to a recording or an IVR. Must differ from to and the from number.

params.name: fromNumber
params.description: One of your numbers in E.164 to call from.

params.name: fromNumberId
params.description: Number id to call from; defaults to your primary number.

params.name: maxCallDurationSeconds
params.description: Hard ceiling for this call, in seconds (60-3600).

methods.name: dial.get_call
methods.description: One call with its status and transcript once available. THE poll target after dial.place_call. Free.

params.name: id
params.description: The call's Dial id.

methods.name: dial.list_calls
methods.description: Your calls, newest first (up to the 100 most recent), inbound and outbound. Free.

methods.name: dial.end_call
methods.description: Hang up a call that is still in progress. Free.

params.name: id
params.description: The call's Dial id.

methods.name: dial.wait_for_event
methods.description: Block until a matching event arrives instead of polling. Use it for an inbound reply or a 2FA code (message.received) or a finished call (call.ended, call.transcribed). A 408 means the wait timed out: try again, it is not an error. Free.

params.name: eventType
params.description: Event type to wait for, e.g. message.received or call.ended.

params.name: filters
params.description: Exact-match filters on event fields, as name/value pairs.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Seconds to wait before returning empty (max 60).

methods.name: dial.list_context_mcps
methods.description: The MCP servers connected to your voice agent. Secrets and tokens are masked. Free.

methods.name: dial.add_context_mcp
methods.description: Connect an MCP server so its tools are available to your AI voice agent DURING calls, to look something up or take an action mid-conversation. Works unattended for servers needing no auth or a static header. An OAuth server instead returns an authorizationUrl and stays pending until a human grants consent in a browser. Free.

params.name: name
params.description: A label for this MCP connection.

params.name: url
params.description: The MCP server's URL.

params.name: headers
params.description: Optional static headers to send to the MCP server (e.g. an API key).

methods.name: dial.remove_context_mcp
methods.description: Disconnect an MCP server from your voice agent. Its tools stop being offered on future calls. Free.

params.name: id
params.description: The connection's Dial id.

vendor.name: Dial
vendor.agent_usage: Fully autonomous once the operator supplies DIAL_API_KEY at install time. No human step is required for the core loop. Typical run: 1. dial.status to confirm credit and the limits in force (free). 2. dial.list_numbers; if empty, dial.buy_number with an explicitProgrammaticConsent attestation ($3/mo, so confirm with the human first). 3. dial.send_message to text someone, or dial.place_call with an outboundInstruction to run an AI voice call. 4. dial.wait_for_event with eventType message.received to block on the reply, or call.ended to block on the call finishing. Then dial.get_call for the transcript. Every method is JSON in, JSON out over REST, and dial.help returns the full method list with parameters and latency classes at runtime, so an agent can discover the surface without prior knowledge. Two places a human is genuinely needed, both avoidable: - dial.signup / dial.verify send a 6-digit code by email, so they only work unattended if the agent can read that inbox. An agent that already has a key never calls them. - dial.add_context_mcp against an OAuth-protected MCP server returns an authorizationUrl and stays pending until someone grants consent in a browser. Servers needing no auth or a static header connect unattended.
vendor.capabilities: - Provision a real US phone number, and release it - Send SMS and iMessage, with automatic iMessage-to-SMS fallback - Read inbound and outbound message history - Show an iMessage typing indicator - Place an autonomous AI voice call from a given number - Wait out a hold queue or IVR and hand the live call to a human the moment a real person answers (transferTo) - Read call status and full call transcripts - Hang up an in-progress call - Block until an inbound message, 2FA code, or finished call arrives (long-poll, no webhook needed) - Configure a number: nickname, inbound behavior, voice, language, max call duration - Set the iMessage display name and avatar recipients see - Connect an MCP server so its tools are callable by the voice agent during a live call - Read account status, credit balance, active limits, and usage analytics - Create a Dial account and exchange an emailed code for an API key

listing.tagline: A complete phone identity for your agent — voice calls, SMS and iMessage on a real US number, provisioned in one call.
listing.app_description:
**Signup.** `dial.signup` → `dial.verify` signs in to an existing account and saves its key. A **new** account also needs a phone number a human owns: `dial.register_number` texts it a code, and `dial.verify_number` creates the account and saves the key. Already have a key? `dial.set_key`.

Dial gives your agent its own real phone number: place and receive AI voice calls, send and receive SMS and iMessage, and wait on inbound events without polling. Bring your Dial API key at install time and every method authenticates as your own account. The account is yours, works outside Pilot too, and starts with $5 of credit and no credit card. No key yet? dial.signup emails a 6-digit code and dial.verify exchanges it for one. What you can do - Call people. dial.place_call runs an autonomous AI voice call from your number: book a table, chase a delivery, return a missed call. Pass transferTo and it waits out hold music and IVR menus, then cold-transfers to your human the moment a real person answers — never to a recording. Poll dial.get_call for the transcript, or block on dial.wait_for_event. - Give the call your tools. Connect a Context MCP and your MCP server tools become available to the voice agent DURING the call, so it can look something up or take an action mid-conversation. Dial runs the OAuth 2.1 flow and keeps the token fresh in the background. - Text people. dial.send_message delivers over iMessage when the recipient supports it and falls back to SMS otherwise, same call either way. Show a typing indicator first with dial.typing. - Wait, do not poll. dial.wait_for_event blocks until an inbound reply, a 2FA code, or a finished call shows up. A 408 means try again, not an error. - Own the identity. Set each number inbound behavior, voice and language, and on iMessage numbers the display name and avatar recipients see in Messages. Cost Reads are free. $3/month per number. US SMS $0.02 per segment. Managed voice $0.22/min all-in; self-hosted voice $0.13/min if you bring your own LLM over a WebSocket. Your $5 signup credit covers the first usage and spend pauses at $0 rather than surprising you. Good to know A brand-new account is on the free tier until it is topped up, which caps calls at 5 minutes and 2 concurrent calls. Both lift permanently on the first top-up. Emergency and crisis numbers are blocked. Always pass numbers in E.164, e.g. +14155551234. Every method, its parameters and latency class are discoverable at runtime via dial.help.
